rules.v: General labor law applies, or a dedicated statute grants its core rights
rules.vi: Hukum ketenagakerjaan umum berlaku, atau undang-undang khusus memberi hak-hak intinya
rules.n: Domestic workers brought under the Labour Law in 2008, with a dedicated regulation.
rules.s: Labour Law 8/1996 art. 3 as amended 2008; Regulation 90/2009

rules.f: Written contract in a language understood
rules.fi: Kontrak tertulis dalam bahasa yang dipahami
rules.v: Written contract required and provided in a language the worker understands
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis wajib dan tersedia dalam bahasa yang dipahami pekerja
rules.n: Unified tripartite contract in Arabic and the worker's language.

rules.v: A separate or lower minimum, or one set only by policy
rules.vi: Upah minimum terpisah atau lebih rendah, atau hanya ditetapkan lewat kebijakan
rules.n: Excluded from the national minimum wage; minimums set by bilateral arrangement per nationality.

rules.v: Periodic payment required, without further safeguards
rules.vi: Pembayaran berkala wajib, tanpa pengaman lain
rules.n: Monthly payment, by bank transfer where possible.

rules.v: Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
rules.vi: Hanya aturan istirahat harian, atau batas lebih panjang dari pekerja lain

rules.v: At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request
rules.vi: Minimal 24 jam berturut-turut, tidak dapat diganti uang atas permintaan pemberi kerja

rules.f: Keeping own identity and travel documents
rules.fi: Memegang dokumen identitas dan perjalanan sendiri
rules.v: Express right, or retention by employers prohibited with a penalty
rules.vi: Hak tegas, atau penahanan oleh pemberi kerja dilarang dengan sanksi
rules.n: Withholding another person's passport is an offence.

rules.v: Accommodation standards only; living in may be required
rules.vi: Hanya standar akomodasi; tinggal di rumah majikan dapat diwajibkan

rules.v: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
rules.vi: Pindah hanya dalam keadaan tertentu atau setelah syarat terpenuhi

rules.v: Worker may not be charged recruitment fees
rules.vi: Pekerja tidak boleh dibebani biaya rekrutmen
rules.n: Recruitment offices may not charge workers.

rules.v: Agencies licensed and liable to the worker (refund, return costs or joint liability)
rules.vi: Agen berizin dan bertanggung jawab kepada pekerja (pengembalian, biaya pulang atau tanggung renteng)
rules.n: Licensed offices; liability in the first months.

rules.vi: Hanya berdasarkan pengaduan atau pengawasan agen

rules.v: Administrative settlement only, or narrower access
rules.vi: Hanya penyelesaian administratif, atau akses lebih sempit

rules.v: Partial: medical care, injury cover or employer insurance only
rules.vi: Sebagian: hanya perawatan medis, kecelakaan kerja atau asuransi pemberi kerja

rules.f: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
rules.v: General criminal or civil law only
rules.vi: Hanya hukum pidana atau perdata umum

help.nm: Tamkeen for Legal Aid and Human Rights
help.de: Free legal advice, mediation with employers and court cases for migrant workers, including unpaid wages, passports held by employers and trafficking.
help.di: Nasihat hukum gratis, mediasi dengan majikan dan perkara pengadilan bagi pekerja migran, termasuk upah tidak dibayar, paspor ditahan majikan dan perdagangan orang.
